Vendored build of `@homenshum/nodegraph-live` ([HomenShum/NodeGraph](https://github.com/HomenShum/NodeGraph) `render/dist`, built from source) — pending npm publish; this copy retires when the package lands.

September 5, 2026 consumer patch: `NodeGraph.js` raises the existing Sigma stage padding from 44 to 88 pixels so the fixed graph-rail fixture's full labels remain inside narrow canvases, including after Fit. Its label-selection grid is 16px: the default 100px grid suppressed nearby names in the compact view. GraphSession, graph-model, filters, edge semantics and public exports are unchanged. This is a local consumer patch, not a new upstream release; the bundled source map predates this settings-only patch. The UI repair browser proof records label bounds and screenshots at 320–1920px. Large arbitrary labels and graphs are outside that fixed-demo proof.
